title: 2012 AMC 12A Problem 1
statement: A bug crawls along a number line, starting at \(-2.\) It crawls to \(-6,\) then turns around and crawls to \(5.\) How many units does the bug crawl altogether?

solutions.text:
The bug crawls \(|-6-(-2)| = 4\) units on the first leg and \(|5-(-6)| = 11\) units on the second leg.

The total distance is \(4 + 11 = 15.\)

Thus, the correct answer is E.
hints: Add the two separate crawl distances rather than the net displacement
The first leg is \(|-6-(-2)|\) and the second is \(|5-(-6)|\)
